name: Carol Pefley
title: Republican nominee for California State Assembly District 28 (2026)
background: Pefley grew up on the Peninsula and is a former journalist and realtor. Her campaign centers on revising recent state housing laws to preserve what she calls the Santa Cruz "mystique". (Lookout Santa Cruz)
She placed second in the June 2, 2026 primary with 28.0%. Through May 16, 2026 she reported about $47,000 in contributions plus a $10,000 loan. (Ballotpedia; Transparency USA)
